rationale: Voltage sag event detected: contiguous interval from 40ms to 100ms where voltage drops below 0.9 PU (the sag threshold). Minimum voltage of 0.58 PU occurs at 80ms. Maximum current of 1.44 PU also occurs during the sag interval. Duration is 60ms (end - start) plus one sample interval of 20ms = 80ms = 0.08s.
